Defines the `select` CLI subcommand for querying OVAL vulnerability data from the local database by package name, CVE ID, or advisory listing.

## Key Components

| Subcommand | Usage | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `select package` | `<family> <release> <package> [arch]` | Queries OVAL definitions by package name, printing CVE IDs and affected packages |
| `select cve-id` | `<family> <release> <cve-id> [arch]` | Queries OVAL definitions by CVE ID, printing advisory titles and CVE metadata |
| `select advisories` | `<family> <release>` | Lists all advisories and their related CVE IDs for a given OS family and release |

**Architecture filtering** (`<arch>`) is only supported for `Amazon`, `Oracle`, and `Fedora` families — other families return an error if the argument is provided.

Each subcommand validates the DB schema version via `GetFetchMeta()` before executing queries, rejecting outdated schemas.

## Usage Example

```bash
# Query by package name
goval-dictionary select package ubuntu 24.04 bash

# Query by package name with architecture (Oracle/Amazon/Fedora only)
goval-dictionary select package oracle 9 bash x86_64

# Query by CVE ID
goval-dictionary select cve-id ubuntu 24.04 CVE-2024-6387

# Query by CVE ID with architecture
goval-dictionary select cve-id oracle 9 CVE-2024-6387 x86_64

# List all advisories for a release
goval-dictionary select advisories ubuntu 24.04
```

Output is printed to stdout in two forms: a human-readable summary followed by a full pretty-printed struct dump (with color disabled) via `pp.Println`.
